description: This source file implements the 'DisplayInfo' plugin for the WPEFramework. It initializes and deinitializes connection properties, handles web requests to provide display information, manages related interfaces such as graphics and HDR properties, and registers the plugin service.

classes.name: DisplayInfo
classes.description: Implements the plugin to gather and report display information, managing connection interfaces and handling web requests.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the plugin, acquiring necessary interfaces and registering this plugin with the system.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and releases interfaces, unregisters the plugin, and terminates the connection.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information (currently empty).

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests, currently supporting only GET to return display information in JSON format.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Gathers various display and connection properties and populates the display info data structure.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, queuing cleanup in a worker thread.
